Name: reference_system_id
Description: Protein-interface system linked to this apo chain

Name: reference_side
Description: Interface side linked to this apo chain: 1 or 2

Name: reference_chain_instance
Description: Assembly-chain instance on the corresponding reference interface side

Name: reference_chain_asym_id
Description: Source asymmetric-chain ID on the corresponding reference interface side

Name: linked_structure_id
Description: Stable identifier for the linked apo chain

Name: source_entry_id
Description: PDB entry containing the linked apo chain

Name: source_chain_asym_id
Description: Source asymmetric-chain ID of the linked apo chain

Name: source_chain_auth_id
Description: Author chain ID of the linked apo chain

Name: source_biounit_id
Description: Source biological assembly containing the apo chain

Name: source_chain_instance
Description: Exact biological-assembly chain instance that was scored

Name: source_num_contacting_proteins
Description: Number of other protein chains contacting the apo chain

Name: source_num_contacting_ions
Description: Number of ion chains contacting the apo chain

Name: source_num_contacting_artifacts
Description: Number of crystallization-artifact chains contacting the apo chain

Name: source_num_contacting_other_ligands
Description: Number of other ligand chains contacting the apo chain

Name: source_resolution
Description: Experimental resolution of the apo source entry

Name: rank
Description: Apo candidate rank for this reference interface side

Name: mmseqs_fident
Description: MMseqs sequence identity between reference and apo chains

Name: mmseqs_query_coverage
Description: Fraction of the reference chain covered by the MMseqs alignment

Name: mmseqs_target_coverage
Description: Fraction of the apo chain covered by the MMseqs alignment

Name: foldseek_lddt
Description: Foldseek local-distance difference test score for the same chain pair
